units.source: Render Note is a special case of __TRILIUM_PH_0__front-end scripting__TRILIUM_PH_1__ which allows rendering custom content inside a note. This makes it possible to create custom dashboards, or to use a custom note editor.
units.context: Render Note

units.source: The content can either be a vanilla HTML, or Preact JSX.

units.source: Printing__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Render Note > Printing

units.source: A render note can be printed or exported as PDF from the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ once its __TRILIUM_PH_2__ relation is set (see __TRILIUM_PH_3__Printing & Exporting as PDF__TRILIUM_PH_4__). Unlike other notes, it is printed exactly as it is displayed: the script does not run again, so what was typed, selected or loaded in the note is kept.
units.context: Render Note > Printing

units.source: The content is laid out again at the width of the page, so elements sized by the script for the screen (such as charts) might not fit.
units.context: Render Note > Printing

units.source: Scrolling areas, such as a table in a scrolling container, are printed at their full height, without a scrollbar.
units.context: Render Note > Printing

units.source: To adjust the layout for printing, use a __TRILIUM_PH_0__ relation.
units.context: Render Note > Printing

units.source: The light colors are used for printing, whatever the current theme.
units.context: Render Note > Printing

units.source: When a render note is printed as part of a __TRILIUM_PH_0__List View__TRILIUM_PH_1__ collection, or from another view such as its attachments, it is not on screen, so its script runs again for the print. In a collection, the output is printed without the note's own styles.
units.context: Render Note > Printing
